newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk party to try to halt Bulgarian deportation.
newsitem.headline: Turk party to try to halt Bulgarian deportation.

text.p: Turkey's main opposition party said on Monday it would apply to parliament to halt the planned expulsion from the country of tens of thousands of ethnic Turkish Bulgarians.
"Deportation of our kin means sending them to starvation and poverty," Motherland Party (ANAP) leader Mesut Yilmaz said in a statement. "We will bring the subject to parliament," he said.
An interior ministry official said last week the government had sent a directive which ordered local governors to expel around 70,000 Bulgarians whose visas had expired.
Turkey began giving citizenship to ethnic Turks, many of whom had fled Sofia's forced assimilation, in 1989.
But Turks kept migrating for economic reasons after Turco-Bulgarian relations improved and automatic citizenship was halted in 1993.
